productionDriftAudit.businessSignal: Post-cutover evidence can be audited for public state drift without resolving private endpoints or copying private receipt payloads.

ownerSlaMonitor.businessSignal: Owner SLA rows make due-soon and overdue responsibility visible while leaving receipt closure authority outside the public package.

releaseFreezeReplay.businessSignal: Release freeze can replay pause, write-deny, rollback preview, emergency stop, and SLA notice without production writes.

guardrails: Drift audit compares public evidence state only.
Owner SLA monitor escalates responsibility but cannot close receipts.
Release freeze replay cannot unfreeze endpoint routes without private owner approval.
Any private value exposure or non-zero live write blocks the package.
